summary: At admitted v54 step 511, the source-owned grow_up message selects the wrong grammatical species name. C prints “The elf-lord becomes an Elvenking.”; JS prints “The elf-lord becomes an elven monarch.” In makemon.c:grow_up, fem is an unsigned 0/1; JS keeps the fallback mtmp.female as a boolean, so pmname indexes no gender slot and falls back to neutral. The five-character longer neutral name explains the cursor offset. The later step 527 multishot missile ordinal remains a separate objnam.c:mshot_xname frontier.

source.branch: When grow_up advances a monster into another species with neither M2_MALE nor M2_FEMALE, C preserves mtmp->female in unsigned fem and uses that 0/1 index in pmname; the JS fallback currently passes Boolean false/true as the array index and therefore selects the neutral name.
callers: muse.c:use_misc -> grow_up for MUSE_POT_GAIN_LEVEL; JS js/muse.js:use_misc -> js/makemon.js:grow_up. This selected session exercises the visible potion advancement path.
dependencies: do_name.c:pmname existing JS implementation in js/do_name.js

evidence: At makemon.c:grow_up:2095-2117, C sets unsigned fem to 0 for M2_MALE, 1 for M2_FEMALE, or mtmp->female (an integer boolean); its growth message formats pmname(ptr, fem) at 2141-2150. PM_ELVENKING in include/monsters.h:2679-2685 has neither male nor female flags and names [Elvenking, Elvenqueen, elven monarch].

At js/makemon.js:431-451, the same fallback assigns mtmp.female directly; Boolean false/true is not an array index in js/do_name.js:1239-1244, so pmname falls back to NEUTRAL. Replaying the admitted recording on e22b0430f9c5b92f507d9f11860a593a40d5885e emits `The elf-lord becomes an elven monarch.` with cursor [78,0,1]; the saved C step 511 emits `The elf-lord becomes an Elvenking.` with cursor [74,0,1].

The exact v54 session is unchanged (manifest cc258ba889b65b063f34199074d3313017b5d89ce3c175bb5443889ef9713e8e; recording b8b44533f0920ce54201cb4639f19ae5b6b56fb8ba3173161062128d28595f3c; recipe aa65292894c61d003af72136b11d3407c47b54a3bd7e1604fcf84dc027a2d557). Accepted baseline 3d403994ae35fe3f31ee2f3b856002abe1c79933 reports 526/778 screens and cursors, 5001 RNG, error null, with 252 screens remaining.

C and JS both use the source branch `humanoid(ptr) ? becomes : grows up into`; the observed verb already matches. The remaining case boundary at step 527 is separately identified as unsupported multishot missile ordinal naming in objnam.c:mshot_xname and is outside grow_up.
